item.description: The Kerala Story 2: Goes Beyond collected Rs. 4.75 crore nett approx on Sunday, and with that, it wrapped its two-day opening weekend at Rs. 10 crore nett approx. The film faced legal hurdles, as the Kerala High Court had stayed its release on Thursday, and the order was reversed only on Friday, allowing shows to begin in the evening.
